description:
Tune a linear plant and write a zero-heap C99 bundle.

The reply's ``codegen`` object lists ``mpc_bundle.h`` and ``mpc_bundle.c``
plus ``usage_example_c`` and ``controller_kind``. A linear plant is a
condensed QP (``linear_qp``). A nonlinear plant, including differential
drive, is a linearized iteration (``linearized_rti``): one Jacobian of ``f``
at the current ``(x, u, d)``, then projected-gradient steps. That is not a full
nonlinear SQP and not acados SQP-RTI. The exported acados controller is a real SQP;
``SQP_RTI`` is that backend's one-quadratic-program-per-tick mode. Compile with
``gcc -O3 -std=c99 -Wall -Wextra -fPIC -shared -lm``. Each control step is
``mpc_compute_u0`` then, after the plant measurement, ``mpc_observer_update``.
Neither function allocates on the heap. ``MPC_NX``, ``MPC_NU``, ``MPC_ND``,
and ``MPC_HORIZON`` in the header are the array sizes.

Same payment as autotune_template: X-API-Key spends 1 autotune credit, and
a missing key or an empty pack is HTTP 402 for x402.

max_trials.description: Optuna trials before the C99 bundle is written. Default 1. Values below 1 are raised to 1. Paid at $2.00: X-API-Key spends 1 autotune credit, or HTTP 402 is x402 Base USDC. Each call starts a new study and writes a new bundle.

name: autotune_embedded_controller_with_c_codegen
title: Autotune an embedded controller
